### Seam Map Summary

1. **Persistence Seam ([`GukiChatPlugin.loadSettings`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/main.ts#L80-L91) / [`GukiChatPlugin.saveSettings`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/main.ts#L94-L98)):
   - **Mechanism:** Obsidian's native [`loadData()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/main.ts#L81) / [`saveData()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/main.ts#L95) APIs writing to `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/guki-chat/data.json` [measured].
   - **Scope:** Per-plugin and per-vault, **not** per-conversation [measured].
   - **Shape:** [`GukiChatSettings`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/settings-tab.ts#L14-L17) extending [`PermissionSettings`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/core/permission-policy.ts#L44-L50).

2. **Read Seam (Ordered Call Chain):**
   - User clicks history button in [`ChatView`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/chat-view.ts#L629-L656) -> invokes [`HistoryDropdown.toggle()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L121) -> [`HistoryDropdown.openDropdown()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L129).
   - [`openDropdown()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L129) calls `getSessions()` callback -> [`ChatView.onOpen`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/chat-view.ts#L90-L93) -> [`NodeTranscriptStore.listSessions(vaultPath)`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/transcript-store.ts#L87-L92).
   - [`NodeTranscriptStore.listSessions()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/transcript-store.ts#L87) locates CLI project directory and calls [`scanSessionsDir(projectsDir)`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/session-index.ts#L257-L290).
   - [`scanSessionsDir()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/session-index.ts#L257) enumerates `.jsonl` files and calls [`buildSessionSummary(filePath, sessionId)`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/session-index.ts#L190-L246).
   - [`buildSessionSummary()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/session-index.ts#L190) reads transcript lines: genuine `aiTitle` sets `title` (L219); fallback prompt sets `derivedTitle` via [`sanitizeDerivedTitle()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/session-index.ts#L149) (L242).
   - [`scanSessionsDir()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/session-index.ts#L257) sorts summaries newest-first and returns [`SessionSummary[]`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/session-index.ts#L14-L31).
   - [`HistoryDropdown.openDropdown()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L132) maps items through [`shapeSessionRow()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L58-L74), producing [`HistoryRowItem`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L16-L22).
   - [`HistoryDropdown.render()`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L208-L256) constructs DOM `.guki-history-item` containing `.guki-history-title`.
   - **The single place to consult stored titles:** [`NodeTranscriptStore.prototype.listSessions`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/data/transcript-store.ts#L87). Overlaying stored titles onto `summary.title` in `listSessions` means **zero UI callers have to change**, because [`shapeSessionRow`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L58) already accords highest priority to `summary.title` [measured].

3. **Write Trigger Seam:**
   - **Session ID acquisition:** Fresh sessions learn `sessionId` only after spawning when the CLI sends [`SystemInitEvent`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/cli/events.ts#L18-L19) (`system/init`), captured in [`StreamReducer.applyInit`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/core/stream-reducer.ts#L398-L405) [measured].
   - **First user prompt:** Observed in [`SessionManager.send`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/core/session-manager.ts#L314-L325) (UI origin: [`ComposerOptions.onSubmit`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/chat-view.ts#L118-L121)) [measured].
   - **First assistant reply completion:** Observed in [`StreamReducer.applyResult`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/core/stream-reducer.ts#L839-L960) and dispatched to [`SessionManager.reducer.onTurnEnd`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/core/session-manager.ts#L118-L125) [measured].
   - **Keying feasibility:** Because `applyInit` executes at turn start before the assistant reply arrives, a generation triggered at the end of the first assistant reply (`applyResult` / `onTurnEnd`) can safely and reliably key by `sessionId` [inferred]. It cannot be keyed before the first message is sent [measured].

4. **Refresh Seam:**
   - [`HistoryDropdown`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L76-L315) builds its DOM strictly once per open [measured].
   - If an asynchronous title arrives while the dropdown is open, **nothing in current code makes it appear** [measured]. The user must toggle the dropdown closed and open again to trigger re-rendering.

5. **Rename Seam:**
   - No existing UI allows editing labels [measured].
   - Nearest architectural pattern to follow: [`AskUserQuestionInline`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/ask-user-question.ts#L178-L220) for dynamic `<input type="text">` creation with `blur`/`keydown` handlers, and [`GukiSettingTab.renderRememberedList`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/settings-tab.ts#L186-L206) for per-row action buttons [measured].

### Answers to Question 6 (Offline Scaffold Observability)

1. **Could a check assert that a title was stored?**
   **YES.**
   Existing precedent in [`docs/offline-checks.ts`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/docs/offline-checks.ts#L6413-L6800) (Section Y) intercepts [`plugin.saveData`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/docs/offline-checks.ts#L6424) to assert on persisted payloads; checks can also inspect files written to temporary directories.

2. **Could a check assert that the list read the stored title rather than recomputing?**
   **YES.**
   Existing precedent in [`docs/offline-checks.ts`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/docs/offline-checks.ts#L12337-L12343) (Section AN) directly queries `.guki-history-item` DOM text rendered by [`HistoryDropdown`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/history-dropdown.ts#L76); checks can assert the rendered title matches the stored title instead of the derived prompt fallback, and spy on scanner/fallback methods to verify non-recomputation.

3. **Could a check assert that no generation call happened when a title already exists?**
   **YES.**
   Existing precedent in [`docs/offline-checks.ts`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/docs/offline-checks.ts#L12531-L12560) (Section AP) wraps and spies on process spawning (`cp.spawn`) to assert invocation counts; any generation trigger (CLI process spawn, HTTP request, or title generation service) can be spied on to assert 0 calls occur when a title already exists.

---

### What Could Not Be Determined

Whether the spec intends generated titles to be stored directly inside [`data.json`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/data.json) under [`GukiChatSettings`](file:///Users/emregultekir/Documents/otherprojects/guki-obsidian-chat/src/ui/settings-tab.ts#L14-L17) (e.g. `sessionTitles: Record<string, string>`) or in a dedicated per-vault sidecar index/file (e.g. `.obsidian/plugins/guki-chat/titles.json`). Both share the same per-vault lifecycle, but have different scalability implications if hundreds of sessions accumulate over time.
